_readme_3: This file defines all checksheet watcher locations.
_readme_4: Each watcher monitors a folder and processes workbook files.
_readme_6: HOW TO ADD A NEW WATCHER:
_readme_7: 1. Copy an existing watcher entry from watch_directories.
_readme_8: 2. Set watch_id to a unique business identifier.
_readme_9: 3. Set source_path to the source workbook folder.
_readme_10: 4. Enable the watcher by setting enabled=true.
_readme_18: change_check_interval_minutes = How often existing files are re-hashed and checked for modifications.
_readme_20: max_retry_attempts = Maximum automatic retries before AWAITING_REVIEW.
_readme_21: poll_interval_sec = How often new files are detected.
_readme_22: stable_wait_sec = Delay between file stability checks.
_readme_23: stable_required_count = Number of stable checks before processing starts.
_readme_25: enabled = Enables or disables the watcher.
_readme_32: After max retries the file is moved to AWAITING_REVIEW.
